portInfo.description: Trondheim Port Authority (TPA) operates ISPS cruise facilities in Trondheim. The dedicated cruise quay 68 at Brattøra is published at 96 m length and 13 m depth and has received Queen Mary 2 and MSC Meraviglia. Ila 30 (280 m / 8 m) is attributed when 68 is unavailable; Pir 1 appears in the cruise quay table with afternoon availability notes. Anchored ships may tender to the Skansen floating bridge (~1300 m from anchorage per 2026 terms). Max 4 cruise ships / 9,000 pax per day in port on the terms sheet. Door GPS null.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 15-20 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Trondheim city centre / Nidaros area (destination framing)
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Quay 68 vs Ila 30 vs Skansen tender before planning walk times.
